title: Events alert — 2026-11-04
body:
Landing now: Tuesday's prints re-confirmed AI capex. AMD +7–9% after hours — record $13.38B revenue (+45%), data center $8.55B (+97%), Q4 guide ~$17B vs $16.2B street. Arista +11–15% (rev $3.66B, +58%; Q4 guide $3.9–4.0B vs ~$3.6B). Super Micro +7–10% ($19.9B quarter; FY27 guide $72–82B). Astera beat-and-raised but flat — the bar is high. Eaton (power sleeve) rose 5.9% intraday on a third 2026 guide raise, then faded; Talen closed +3.1%. Contrast Intel's −25.6%: semis and grid equipment both intact.

Tonight, 22:15 Berlin / 16:15 ET: Arm (Q2 FY27; ~$0.42–0.47 EPS, ~$1.38B revenue; options imply ±15%) and Coherent — optical bar is high after Lumentum's +136% YoY. Semis momentum restored; infrastructure on watch; cash sleeve parked into Friday's NFP.

Sources: web search 2026-11-04 (Yahoo/Investing.com/IBD, EarningsWhispers, Arm IR). After-hours and intraday moves as reported; some Eaton close figures conflict across outlets.
